page.layout: One page of running text, full width. Heading at top with division title. Hebrew letter lists and Hebrew words set on separate lines within the text. No marginal notes. Catchword "Servi-" at lower right.

main_text.head: SECT. 3. De Literarum divisionibus.
main_text.p: Literas distinguunt Hebræi ut omnes Ori-entales in 5 classes, secundum 5 organa pro-nunciandi.
main_text.l: Dentales ש ם צ ר ו [?]
main_text.p: De hisce est regula generalis, quod literæ ejusdem organi facilè inter se permutantur, quod frequentissimè fit in vocibus ex una lingua in alteram traductis.

Radicales Thema, seu Radicem constituunt, quæ plærumque ex tribus literis constat, raro ex pluribus, quomodo omnes literæ possunt esse radicales; sed hic peculiariter intelliguntur ea quæ semper sunt de radice, nunquam serviles: sunt q; ꝗ 1, his dictionibus cōprehensæ, חש ספר נועצק [?]
Servites sunt quæ flexione vel formatione radici inserviunt; aliquando tamen sunt de radice, ut reliquæ 11, in has voces memoriales collectæ, משׁה וכלב איתן [?]

page.notes: Hebrew lines are transcribed in the order printed; the Palati and Dentales lines are partly obscured. "Servites" is as printed and may be a misprint for "Serviles" [?]. "ex-pluribus" hyphen uncertain. The Hebrew line after "cōprehensæ" and the memorial words are uncertain. Long s rendered as s throughout.
